{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches doc/bips.md only to document the BIP 54 deployment parameter alongside the code changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Updating bips.md is ancillary documentation that follows the implementation of the consensus deployment."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/chainparams.cpp to register deployment parameters without altering kernel APIs or boundary behavior.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Changes to chain parameters compile into the kernel library but do not touch the kernel API or architecture."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/policy/policy.cpp and mempool tests only to align standardness rules with the new consensus constraints.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The mempool and policy edits are mechanical downstream adaptations to the BIP 54 consensus validation rules."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifies miner.cpp by 3 lines to ensure coinbase timelocks satisfy BIP 54 rules on regtest.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Minor adjustments to block template coinbase construction follow directly from consensus rule changes."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches test/functional/p2p_segwit.py purely for functional test adjustments.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR does not touch p2p transport, protocol messages, or network connection handling."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds BIP 54 deployment status reporting to getblockchaininfo in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Reporting a new versionbits deployment is standard expository behavior and not a substantive RPC interface change."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "The extensive unit tests, fuzz targets, and functional tests specifically validate BIP 54 consensus rules rather than the general testing framework.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Tests pinning the behavior of a specific consensus deployment belong to validation rather than test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements BIP 54 consensus validation rules in src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp and src/validation.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.72,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "BIP 54 resolves long-standing consensus flaws including quadratic legacy sigops CPU exhaustion, CVE-2017-12842 64-byte transaction collisions, and timewarp attacks. Because this PR explicitly defines the deployment as inactive on mainnet, testnet, and signet, it serves as strategically important soft fork preparation and regtest test harness rather than an immediate mainnet security fix."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches test/functional/wallet_migration.py and wallet_ancient_migration.py to adjust block heights and sequence numbers for regtest.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Incidental updates to wallet functional tests to satisfy new regtest consensus rules do not constitute wallet development."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 2,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}
